brand.q: How do I create a campaign?
brand.a: Navigate to Campaigns in the sidebar and click 'New Campaign' to get started.
Open a campaign, go to the Gigs tab, and use the invite action to send invitations to creators.
You are billed per campaign based on your selected plan. Visit Settings > Billing for details.
Open a gig from your campaign and navigate to the Submissions tab to review creator content.
Yes, you can create and manage multiple campaigns simultaneously from the Campaigns section.

creator.q: How do I join a campaign?
creator.a: Browse available gigs in the Gigs section and click Apply to submit your application.
Payouts are processed within 14 days of your content being approved by the brand.
Open your active gig from the Gigs section and click Submit to upload your video.
The brand will review your submission and either approve, return, or reject it with feedback.

creator.q: How do I update my profile?
creator.a: Go to My Profile in the sidebar to update your bio, categories, and social media links.

admin.a: Navigate to Users in the main navigation to view, edit, or deactivate accounts.

admin.q: How do I review brand profiles?
admin.a: Go to Brands, open a brand profile, and use the action menu to update their status.

admin.q: How do I assign a support case?
admin.a: Open a case from the Cases page and use the action menu to assign it to an admin.

admin.q: How do I approve a campaign?
admin.a: Go to Campaigns, open the campaign, and use the action menu to accept or reject it.

admin.q: How do I send platform notifications?
admin.a: Navigate to Notifications and use the Create Notification button to send targeted messages.
